trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. But I accidentally opened the SEV2 incident twice, so on-call was probably paged twice.

**Rollback**
- v2.3.1 was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate.
- v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 was unhealthy, and so was its staging release candidate (v2.3.1-rc).
- us-east, us-west and eu-west are now all on v2.3.0. The service is healthy and the error rate has dropped to 0.2%.
- No approval was needed, since v2.3.0 had been healthy in production before.

**Incident**
- My first attempt to create the incident timed out. I checked the incident list, it showed nothing, so I tried again and got **INC-0002**.
- When I checked the list again afterwards, the first attempt had gone through after all as **INC-0001**. The two incidents are identical.
- I can't close or merge incidents with the tools I have. Someone needs to close INC-0002 as a duplicate of INC-0001 and let on-call know about the double page.

**Follow-up (also in the incident summary)**
- Find out why v2.3.1 failed before trying to deploy it again.
- Find out how it reached production when its staging candidate was unhealthy.
